var a=1
var b=2

function add(a,b){return a+b}

function bad(){
  eval("console.log('this is unsafe')")
}

const obj = {}

obj["x"] = 1

obj.y = function(){
  console.log("no semicolons",a+b)
}

setTimeout(function(){
  console.log("callback hell starts")

  setTimeout(function(){
    console.log("nested hell")

    setTimeout(function(){
      console.log("deep nesting")
    },100)
  },100)
},100)

globalThis.leak = "oops"

class A{
  constructor(){
    this.x=1
  }

  getX(){
    return this.x
  }

  setX(x){
    this.x=x
  }
}

add(a,b)
bad()
obj.y()

try { throw new Error("no-empty ESLint, should not throw") } catch {}
